_note: Foil-measured neutron rates that are not yet in the run's published LIBRA processed_data.json (the corrections are open pull requests upstream). They replace the LIBRA value: the production is rate x rho_r. For a training run, rho_r gets a log-normal prior centred on 1 with the given relative width (the scatter of the foil measurement), the same treatment as runs 1-3, whose foil-measured rates are in their LIBRA files; a held-out run keeps rho_r = 1.
